statement: Because BlueZ creates Bluetooth-bus HID devices through UHID and the kernel drivers match Bluetooth HID IDs, a virtualgamepad Bluetooth-bus UHID realization appears technically plausible as a host-local representation. It has not been shown to satisfy xpadneo, hid-microsoft or SDL with the correct descriptor, output requests, battery semantics and cleanup; Bluetooth pairing and radio support remain independent work.

applicability.revision: standard Xbox Series controller, model 1914, with explicitly labelled older/Elite comparators
applicability.scope: Inference for virtualgamepad docs/XBOX_SERIES.md and #160/#164. No physical device, host test or pairing performed; no realization status promotion.
